summary: Closure review: the authors executed a transparent preregistered paired shared_initial_candidate study with complete archival artifacts. However the previous required revisions were not fully addressed: the Disclosure Statement still enumerates per-file/run artifacts (prohibited), Related Work contains at least one claim–citation mismatch for generate→validate→repair empirical claims, and Methods lacks the explicit sentence that temperature=null is not evidence of deterministic sampling. These three revisions remain required. Accept for finalisation: no.
critical_issues: Disclosure Statement still lists per-file artifact paths/hashes and other run-level provenance (execution/raw_results.jsonl, execution/task_manifest.jsonl, analysis/results.json, etc.). Per the venue rules the manuscript Disclosure must be condensed to the single immutable master_prompt locator+SHA‑256 plus a concise summary of models/adapters/validator/preregistration and autonomy boundary; enumerating file paths or per-file hashes in the Disclosure prose is not permitted.

Related Work contains a methodological claim that "generate–validate–repair pipelines have been shown to improve safety or repairability for program repair and DevOps tasks" with citations [6],[7] that do not clearly substantiate that specific empirical claim given the verified bibliography. Each in-text citation must accurately support the adjacent scholarly claim; either replace or reword the claim to match the supplied verified records or supply corrected IEEE‑style references that do support it (no fabricated metadata).

Methods does not contain the explicit, literal sentence required by the prior review: that temperature=null (as recorded in execution/model_configuration.json) does not imply deterministic model sampling and that the adapter does not guarantee deterministic sampling. The manuscript must add that explicit clarification in Methods (not only in the preregistration language).
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement so it (a) includes exactly one immutable master_prompt locator and its SHA‑256 digest (provenance/master_prompt.txt + SHA‑256) as required, (b) provides a concise summary of models (gpt‑5‑mini), adapter (hosted_netops_gvr_v1), deterministic validator, preregistration id, and the autonomy boundary, and (c) states that the full execution/artifact bundle is archived. Remove all enumerated file paths, per-file hashes, provider‑call filenames, and run‑internal log listings from the Disclosure prose while preserving the single required master_prompt locator+SHA‑256 verbatim.

For each claim in Related Work that cites external literature (notably the claim about generate→validate→repair empirical improvements), verify that the cited record in terminal_bibliographic_records actually supports the immediate claim. If a cited record does not support the claim, either (a) replace the citation with an accurate IEEE‑style reference that does, using only verified records present in the evidence bundle, or (b) weaken/rephrase the claim to match what the verified citations do support. Record the bibliographic corrections concisely in the revision log.

Add one explicit sentence in Methods stating: (i) the run used temperature=null as recorded in execution/model_configuration.json, (ii) null/unset temperature is not evidence of deterministic model sampling (i.e., it does not imply temperature=0), and (iii) the adapter produced exactly one sampled generation per pair that was reused under shared_initial_candidate semantics; reiterate that no claim of deterministic model sampling is being made.
optional_revisions: Include a very short one‑line table or sentence in Methods reporting the observed difficulty label counts (extreme: 40, very_hard: 160) with a reference to the archived task_manifest.jsonl for replay—this aids reader orientation but is not required for reproducibility.

Briefly expand the Discussion (1–2 sentences) to propose a concrete follow‑up preregistered design (e.g., independent two‑call per‑pair regime with an example sample size/model_call budget and a target baseline unsafe rate) to guide readers aiming to avoid the ceiling effect; keep it concise to preserve the five‑page limit.

Move representative long JSON excerpts or per‑episode raw snippets out of main prose into a compact Appendix or figure (or remove them entirely) to improve information density in the five‑page manuscript; rely on the archived artifact bundle as the authoritative source.
